method: Tier-0 primary source (mistral.ai/news) fetched directly and cross-checked against an independent Tier-2 outlet (VentureBeat) per policy/verification.md §1; announcement-type claims about Mistral's own products are Tier-0-sufficient, business/capacity claims cross-checked against VentureBeat's independent reporting for the same 200MW/2027 and 1GW/2030 figures.
origin_items: Surfaced during cycle 1's Tier-0 sweep of mistral.ai/news; carried untriaged into cycle 2, opened for verification this cycle.

claims.text: Mistral Regional Endpoints, letting customers choose Europe or the US for inference processing, are now generally available
claims.reasoning: Stated directly on Mistral's own news post (Tier 0, sufficient alone); independently corroborated by VentureBeat's own description of the same GA status.

claims.text: Mistral Priority Tier, offering committed service levels with custom rate limits and an uptime SLA for mission-critical workloads, entered public preview
claims.reasoning: Stated on Mistral's own post; VentureBeat independently describes the same preview-stage SLA tier.

claims.text: A coalition of European enterprises -- including ASML, CMA CGM, Amadeus and Caisse des Depots -- made multi-year compute commitments that Mistral says will underwrite 200 megawatts of European infrastructure by the end of 2027 and a full gigawatt by the end of 2030
claims.reasoning: Company-stated capacity targets, independently corroborated by VentureBeat reporting the identical 200MW/end-2027 and 1GW/end-2030 figures with its own framing ('lock in customers now'), not a rewrite of Mistral's press language. Named partner list taken from Mistral's own post; figures are forward-looking targets, not built infrastructure -- flagged as such in the article body.

claims.text: Mistral's platform now supports third-party open models in addition to its own, starting with Z.ai's GLM-5.2
claims.reasoning: Stated directly on Mistral's own post; Tier-0-sufficient for this announcement-type detail, no second source found specifically for the GLM-5.2 detail but not required given source tier.

falsifier_notes: Overall verdict: CLEAR TO PUBLISH as confirmed. dedup-check returned zero matches (standalone). VentureBeat's independent framing ('lock in customers now') and Raconteur's separate coverage of the same sovereign-AI push corroborate the core facts without contradiction. Capacity figures (200MW/2027, 1GW/2030) are explicitly presented in the article as Mistral's own targets, not verified built capacity -- no overclaim. No third-party numeric/leaderboard citation requiring the live-fetch rule.
